name: adsense-mcp
description: Read AdSense accounts, inventory, payments, policy, and reports through MCP.

access_token.title: OAuth access token
access_token.description: Optional short-lived access token. Prefer the refresh-token settings below for persistent access.

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: Google Cloud OAuth desktop application's client ID.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: Google Cloud OAuth desktop application's client secret.

refresh_token.title: OAuth refresh token
refresh_token.description: OAuth token granted the AdSense read-only scope.

account.title: AdSense account
account.description: Optional account resource name, e.g. accounts/pub-123. The first accessible account is used when blank.

tools.name: adsense_list_payments
tools.description: List paid and unpaid AdSense earnings.

tools.name: adsense_get_ad_blocking_recovery_tag
tools.description: Get an account's ad-blocking recovery tag.

tools.name: adsense_list_sites
tools.description: List sites and their AdSense state.

tools.name: adsense_get_ad_client_ad_code
tools.description: Get an AdSense ad client's ad code.

tools.name: adsense_get_ad_unit_ad_code
tools.description: Get an AdSense ad unit's ad code.

tools.name: adsense_list_linked_custom_channels
tools.description: List custom channels linked to an ad unit.

tools.name: adsense_list_linked_ad_units
tools.description: List ad units linked to a custom channel.

tools.name: adsense_generate_report
tools.description: Extract an arbitrary AdSense Management API v2 report.
